name: slack-link-formatter
title: Slack Link Formatter
description: A Raycast extension that converts a clipboard URL into a rich title hyperlink for Slack

commands.name: copy-slack-link
commands.title: Copy Slack Link from Clipboard URL
commands.description: Fetches the page title for the URL on your clipboard and copies an HTML anchor with the raw URL as plain-text fallback
